name_input: PARAGON FINE AND SPECIALITY CHEMICAL LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records, company page https://importkey.com/countries/india/paragon-fine-and-speciality-chemical-limited — counter states "Total Shipments 244 Records detected", "Trading Partners 5", "Ports 17", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-18"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows. Exact evidence line (row 1): "2026-02-18 | PARAGON FINE AND SPECIALITY CHEMICAL LIMITED | TO ORDER | CHEMICAL DYE INTERMEDIATES PI/132 AMINECOMPOUND OF NAPHTHAELINE DERIVATIVES OFOXYGEN FUNCTION (DETAILS AS PER INVOICE) | AHEMDABAD ICD INSBI6, India -> Laem Chabang, THAILAND | HS 29211190 | BOL 9770356". Additional visible export rows: 2026-02-17 AHEMDABAD ICD -> Laem Chabang, THAILAND, HS 29270090, BOL 9745587; 2026-02-16 AHEMDABAD ICD -> Laem Chabang, THAILAND, HS 32041218, BOL 9697376; 2026-02-10 AHEMDABAD ICD -> Altamira, MEXICO, HS 29089990, BOL 9551589. Top destination port "Laem Chabang 29" records. Note: the same page also shows import rows (e.g. 2026-02-12 from HANGZHOU PARAMOUNT PRODUCT CORPORATION, K ACID 70% MIN, HS 29214524, BOL 7480122), i.e. the company is both an exporter and an importer of dye intermediates.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS codes (Thailand, Mexico; Feb 2026), not by website claims — 244 records claimed by the counter, 5 rows actually seen in the free view. Declared HS 292221 (aminohydroxynaphthalenesulphonic acids) is close to but not identical to the observed export codes (29211190, 29270090, 32041218, 29089990); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actually shipped codes. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: the search backend returned connection errors on all queries and thecompanycheck/volza returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding of no domestic supply. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the sources read: null, not estimated. PAN AAKCP1837D and state Gujarat were not independently verified in this pass (registries out of scope).
